farm.intro: Meet the farm animals, grow your own vegetables and sell them at the market. Every job on the farm teaches you an action word.
farm.item.apple.note: Apples grow on apple trees in an orchard.
farm.item.apple.s1: There are a lot of apples on the tree.
farm.item.apple.s2: The apples fell off the tree in the strong wind.
farm.item.carrot.s1: The carrots are ready to pick.
farm.item.carrot.s2: Carrots grow best in soft, sandy soil.
farm.item.chicken.fact: A hen can lay about 300 eggs a year.
farm.item.chicken.note: The chicken says cluck. A female chicken is a hen.
farm.item.chicken.s1: The hens lay eggs every day.
farm.item.chicken.s2: The chickens are kept in a coop at night.
farm.item.collect-eggs.s1: We collected twelve eggs this morning.
farm.item.collect-eggs.s2: The eggs must be collected carefully so they don't break.
farm.item.corn.note: Uncountable: some corn, an ear of corn.
farm.item.corn.s1: The corn grows very tall in summer.
farm.item.corn.s2: Popcorn is made from a special kind of corn.
farm.item.cow.fact: A cow can give about 30 litres of milk a day.
farm.item.cow.s2: The farmer milks the cows every morning.
farm.item.donkey.fact: Donkeys have very long ears to hear far away.
farm.item.donkey.s1: The donkey is carrying a heavy bag.
farm.item.donkey.s2: Donkeys are famous for being stubborn.
farm.item.feed.s1: The farmer fed the pigs an hour ago.
farm.item.feed.s2: The animals are fed twice a day.
farm.item.goat.note: A baby goat is called a kid.
farm.item.goat.s1: The goat is climbing on a rock.
farm.item.goat.s2: Goats will try to eat almost anything.
farm.item.harvest.s1: We harvested a lot of corn this year.
farm.item.harvest.s2: The harvest was smaller because of the dry summer.
farm.item.horse.s2: The horse is used to pull the old cart.
farm.item.milk.note: Also a noun: a glass of milk.
farm.item.milk.s1: Have you ever milked a cow?
farm.item.milk.s2: Cows are usually milked early in the morning.
farm.item.pig.fact: Pigs roll in mud to stay cool.
farm.item.pig.s1: The pigs are playing in the mud.
farm.item.pig.s2: Pigs are cleverer than most people think.
farm.item.plant.s2: Seeds should be planted in spring.
farm.item.potato.s1: We dig the potatoes out of the ground.
farm.item.potato.s2: Potatoes can be boiled, fried or baked.
farm.item.pumpkin.s0: The pumpkin is big and orange.
farm.item.pumpkin.s1: This pumpkin is heavier than that one.
farm.item.pumpkin.s2: People carve faces into pumpkins at Halloween.
farm.item.sheep.fact: Wool for sweaters comes from sheep.
farm.item.sheep.note: The sheep says baa. One sheep, two sheep!
farm.item.sheep.s0: The sheep is white and soft.
farm.item.sheep.s1: There are ten sheep in the field.
farm.item.sheep.s2: Sheep are usually sheared once a year.
farm.item.strawberry.s2: Strawberries are the only fruit with seeds on the outside.
farm.item.tomato.s1: We need tomatoes for the salad.
farm.item.tomato.s2: Tomatoes need a lot of sun and water.
farm.item.water.s1: Don't forget to water the tomatoes.
farm.item.water.s2: The plants have been watered twice today.
farm.item.wheat.s1: The farmer harvests the wheat in autumn.
farm.item.wheat.s2: The wheat is ground into flour at the mill.
farm.phrase.11: Could I have a bag of potatoes, please?
farm.phrase.12: It's sunny today. The plants will grow fast.
farm.phrase.13: We need rain. The ground is very dry.
farm.phrase.14: In autumn we harvest the apples.
farm.phrase.3: Be careful, the horse might kick.
farm.phrase.6: When will the pumpkins be ready?
farm.phrase.7: Can you help me harvest the corn?
farm.title: Green Valley Farm
restaurant.intro: Take a seat, read the menu and order your meal from the waiter. Learn food words and the phrases you need from booking a table to paying the bill.
restaurant.item.bill.s1: Can we have the bill, please?
restaurant.item.bill.s2: Is service included in the bill?
restaurant.item.burger.note: Beef burger with cheese and fries.
restaurant.item.burger.s1: Can I have the burger without cheese?
restaurant.item.burger.s2: The veggie burger is a good choice if you don't eat meat.
restaurant.item.chocolate-cake.s1: Can I have a piece of chocolate cake?
restaurant.item.chocolate-cake.s2: The chocolate cake is our most popular dessert.
restaurant.item.coffee.s1: Can I have a coffee after the meal?
restaurant.item.coffee.s2: Would you like your coffee now or with the dessert?
restaurant.item.curry.s2: I'd like the curry, but could you make it a bit milder?
restaurant.item.fork.s1: Could I have another fork, please?
restaurant.item.fork.s2: I dropped my fork. Could you bring me a clean one?
restaurant.item.fruit-salad.s1: I'll have the fruit salad for dessert.
restaurant.item.fruit-salad.s2: The fruit salad is a lighter option after a big meal.
restaurant.item.garden-salad.s1: Could I have the salad without onions?
restaurant.item.garden-salad.s2: The dressing is served on the side, so you can add as much as you like.
restaurant.item.garlic-bread.s1: Can we share the garlic bread?
restaurant.item.garlic-bread.s2: The garlic bread goes really well with the soup.
restaurant.item.grilled-fish.note: Fish of the day with rice and lemon.
restaurant.item.grilled-fish.s1: The grilled fish comes with rice.
restaurant.item.grilled-fish.s2: Is the fish fresh today, or was it frozen?
restaurant.item.ice-cream.s1: Two scoops of vanilla ice cream, please.
restaurant.item.ice-cream.s2: We have ice cream in three flavours today.
restaurant.item.menu.s1: Could we see the menu, please?
restaurant.item.napkin.s2: The napkins are next to the plates.
restaurant.item.orange-juice.s1: A glass of orange juice, please.
restaurant.item.orange-juice.s2: The orange juice is freshly squeezed every morning.
restaurant.item.pizza.note: Cheese and tomato, baked in a wood oven.
restaurant.item.pizza.s1: Let's order a pizza to share.
restaurant.item.pizza.s2: The pizza is cut into eight slices.
restaurant.item.roast-chicken.s1: The roast chicken is very popular here.
restaurant.item.roast-chicken.s2: The chicken is roasted slowly, so it stays juicy.
restaurant.item.spaghetti.s1: The spaghetti is a little spicy.
restaurant.item.spaghetti.s2: Would you like some cheese on your spaghetti?
restaurant.item.steak.note: Grilled beef with fries. Rare, medium or well done.
restaurant.item.steak.s1: I would like my steak medium, please.
restaurant.item.steak.s2: How would you like your steak cooked?
restaurant.item.table.s2: Could we have a table by the window?
restaurant.item.tea.s1: Could I have some milk with my tea?
restaurant.item.tea.s2: Herbal tea doesn't have any caffeine.
restaurant.item.tomato-soup.s1: I would like the tomato soup to start.
restaurant.item.tomato-soup.s2: The soup is made with fresh tomatoes from the farm.
restaurant.item.water.s1: Could we have a bottle of sparkling water?
restaurant.item.water.s2: Tap water is free if you ask for it.
restaurant.phrase.1: I have a reservation for seven o'clock.
restaurant.phrase.10: Excuse me, this isn't what I ordered.
restaurant.phrase.11: My soup is cold. Could you warm it up, please?
restaurant.phrase.12: Could we have the bill, please?
restaurant.phrase.3: Can I see the menu, please?
restaurant.phrase.4: I'd like the grilled fish, please.
restaurant.phrase.6: Could I have the same, please?
restaurant.phrase.7: I'm vegetarian. Which dishes have no meat?
restaurant.phrase.9: Could I have it without onions?
restaurant.title: The Grand Garden Restaurant
supermarket.intro: Take a shopping list, find the products on the shelves and pay at the checkout. Learn food words, how to count them and how to talk about prices.
supermarket.item.apples.s1: I need a bag of apples.
supermarket.item.apples.s2: These apples are on sale this week.
supermarket.item.bananas.s2: Bananas are cheaper when you buy them loose.
supermarket.item.bread.note: Uncountable: a loaf of bread, some bread.
supermarket.item.bread.s2: The bread is baked here every morning.
supermarket.item.cake.s0: The cake is for my sister.
supermarket.item.cake.s1: Do you have chocolate birthday cakes?
supermarket.item.cake.s2: You can order a cake with a name on it.
supermarket.item.cheese.s1: How much is this piece of cheese?
supermarket.item.cheese.s2: The cheese counter is at the back of the shop.
supermarket.item.chicken.s2: The chicken should be kept in the fridge.
supermarket.item.chips.note: a bag of chips (British English: crisps)
supermarket.item.chips.s2: In British English, chips are called crisps.
supermarket.item.chocolate.s2: Dark chocolate has less sugar than milk chocolate.
supermarket.item.croissant.s2: Croissants are cheaper after six in the evening.
supermarket.item.eggs.s2: Check that none of the eggs are broken before you buy them.
supermarket.item.fish.s1: Is this fish fresh or frozen?
supermarket.item.fish.s2: Ask at the fish counter if you want it cleaned.
supermarket.item.frozen-peas.s1: I need a bag of frozen peas.
supermarket.item.frozen-peas.s2: Frozen vegetables are as healthy as fresh ones.
supermarket.item.grapes.s2: Seedless grapes are a little more expensive.
supermarket.item.ice-cream.s2: Put the ice cream in the freezer as soon as you get home.
supermarket.item.juice.s1: A bottle of orange juice, please.
supermarket.item.juice.s2: Buy two bottles of juice and get one free.
supermarket.item.lettuce.s1: I need one lettuce for the salad.
supermarket.item.lettuce.s2: Lettuce stays fresh longer in the fridge.
supermarket.item.milk.s2: Is this milk full-fat or skimmed?
supermarket.item.onions.s2: Onions are sold by weight, so put them on the scale.
supermarket.item.rice.s2: Brown rice takes longer to cook than white rice.
supermarket.item.sausages.s2: These sausages are made without pork.
supermarket.item.soap.s2: This soap is good for sensitive skin.
supermarket.item.soda.s1: Can I have two cans of soda?
supermarket.item.toilet-paper.s1: A pack of toilet paper, please.
supermarket.item.toilet-paper.s2: The big pack is better value for money.
supermarket.item.toothpaste.s2: This toothpaste is good for sensitive teeth.
supermarket.item.water.s1: Where can I find bottled water?
supermarket.item.water.s2: A pack of six bottles is cheaper than six single ones.
supermarket.item.yogurt.s2: Plain yogurt has less sugar than fruit yogurt.
supermarket.phrase.0: Excuse me, where can I find the milk?
supermarket.phrase.1: It's in aisle three, next to the eggs.
supermarket.phrase.11: Here's your change and your receipt.
supermarket.phrase.13: It's on sale: buy one, get one free.
supermarket.phrase.14: This one is cheaper than that one.
supermarket.phrase.15: Is this the cheapest one you have?
supermarket.phrase.2: Do you have any fresh bread?
supermarket.phrase.3: Sorry, we've run out of bananas.
supermarket.phrase.4: How many eggs do we need?
supermarket.phrase.5: How much rice do we need?
supermarket.phrase.6: We need a carton of milk and a loaf of bread.
supermarket.title: FreshWay Supermarket
zoo.intro: Walk around the zoo, meet the animals and learn their names. Tap an animal to hear it, read about it and practise sentences.
zoo.item.bear.fact: Polar bears have black skin under their white fur.
zoo.item.bear.s0: The bear is brown and big.
zoo.item.bear.s2: Many bears sleep through the winter.
zoo.item.crocodile.fact: A crocodile can't stick its tongue out.
zoo.item.crocodile.s1: The crocodile is lying in the water.
zoo.item.crocodile.s2: Crocodiles have lived on Earth since the time of the dinosaurs.
zoo.item.elephant.s1: The elephant is drinking water with its trunk.
zoo.item.elephant.s2: Elephants are known for their excellent memory.
zoo.item.flamingo.fact: Baby flamingos are grey, not pink.
zoo.item.flamingo.s1: The flamingo is standing on one leg.
zoo.item.flamingo.s2: Flamingos get their pink colour from the food they eat.
zoo.item.giraffe.fact: A giraffe's tongue is about 50 centimetres long.
zoo.item.giraffe.s0: The giraffe has a long neck.
zoo.item.giraffe.s1: Giraffes eat leaves from tall trees.
zoo.item.giraffe.s2: A giraffe only needs about two hours of sleep a day.
zoo.item.kangaroo.note: A baby kangaroo is called a joey.
zoo.item.kangaroo.s0: The kangaroo can jump very far.
zoo.item.kangaroo.s1: The baby kangaroo lives in its mother's pouch.
zoo.item.lion.fact: A lion's roar can be heard from 8 kilometres away.
zoo.item.lion.note: A male lion has a mane.
zoo.item.lion.s0: The lion is sleeping in the sun.
zoo.item.lion.s1: Lions live in groups called prides.
zoo.item.lion.s2: If you listen carefully, you can hear the lion roar.
zoo.item.monkey.fact: Some monkeys wash their food before they eat it.
zoo.item.monkey.s0: The monkey is eating a banana.
zoo.item.monkey.s2: Some monkeys use their tails to hold on to branches.
zoo.item.panda.fact: A newborn panda is about the size of a stick of butter.
zoo.item.panda.s0: The panda is black and white.
zoo.item.panda.s1: Pandas eat bamboo almost all day.
zoo.item.panda.s2: Giant pandas spend up to 14 hours a day eating.
zoo.item.penguin.fact: Penguins are birds, but they cannot fly.
zoo.item.penguin.s2: Penguins slide on their bellies to move faster on ice.
zoo.item.tiger.fact: Tigers are the biggest cats in the world.
zoo.item.tiger.s0: The tiger has orange fur and black stripes.
zoo.item.tiger.s2: No two tigers have the same stripes.
zoo.item.zebra.fact: Every zebra has its own pattern of stripes.
zoo.item.zebra.s0: The zebra is black and white.
zoo.item.zebra.s1: Zebras live in big groups called herds.
zoo.item.zebra.s2: Scientists think the stripes help to keep flies away.
zoo.phrase.10: Tigers are more dangerous than pandas.
zoo.phrase.13: Are we allowed to feed the animals?
zoo.phrase.14: Please don't tap on the glass.
zoo.phrase.3: It's sleeping. Let's come back later.
zoo.phrase.6: It can swim, but it can't fly.
zoo.phrase.8: The giraffe is taller than the zebra.
zoo.phrase.9: The elephant is the biggest animal here.
zoo.title: Sunny Hills Zoo
